ABOUT

A focus on spatial understanding.

I am Byeong Gwon Lee, a 3D Computer Vision Researcher at KETI. My work connects camera tracking, dense depth estimation, and 3D reconstruction.

RESEARCH INTERESTS

Learned priors.
Geometric foundations.

I work on online mapping and offline reconstruction, with interests in reliable depth estimation, adaptive view selection, and geometry completion.
